title: 第10章
slug: 惊悚乐园全本免费-惊悚乐园最新章节列表
content_zh:
封不觉惊讶地发现这剑撕开血尸的身体时简直和切豆腐一样容易，那怪物胸前的肌肉和骨头被划开后，鲜血飙射而出，泼了封不觉一脸，一股腥咸之味沁入口鼻，还有粘稠温热的触感，这游戏在这方面可谓以假乱真……和真的一样恶心。
血尸仅仅是被剑割伤了这一下，就发出痛苦的吼叫，身体由伤口处开始，似融化一般迅速变成了肉酱脓水，就这么流淌一地。
封不觉到这时才有机会看一下手中这把剑的属性。
【名称：血尸必须死】
【类型：武器】
【品质：精良】
【攻击力：较强】
【属性：无】
【特效：攻击血尸时可将其溶解】
【是否可带出该剧本：否】
【备注：这把剑是传奇矮人工匠“奥尔·全得死”的早期作品，一名狡猾的哥布林商人用几瓶被称为“二锅头”的饮料就从奥尔那里收购了此剑，半个月后，奥尔制造了“哥布林必须死”。】
封不觉看了几秒这装备的属性，系统提示音便响了起来：【您已完成新手教程，60秒后自动传送】
这时，眼前的游戏菜单里又有一个区域被解锁，那里正在进行60秒的倒计时，还有一个选项是“立即传送”。封不觉选择了立即传送，他的身体就化为白光，瞬间离开了剧本。
从其主观上来看，只是眼前白光一现，便回到了那个电梯里，手中的巨剑已不在，身上的血渍污迹也都消失了。电梯里一切如常，还是最初载入游戏时的样子，灯光很明亮，镜子里自然也只有他一个，刚才那十几分钟所经历的事情就像短暂、虚幻的噩梦。
【剧本已完成，正在结算奖励。】
【获得经验值：70，游戏币：700】
【获得物品装备：无】
【完成接受任务：00】
【特殊、隐藏任务完成：0，破解世界观：无】
【惊吓值激增：0次，最高惊吓值：0%，平均惊吓值：0%】

【您的恐惧评级为：浑身是胆，获得一项额外奖励，请稍后选取。】
【获得技巧值：30】
【技巧值加成经验：30，游戏币：300】
【剧本通关奖励：新手行囊*1。】
【结算已完成，请继续。】
这些信息都显示在墙上的屏幕中，系统提示这时又道：【您已经升到了2级，体能值上限增加，当前为200200】
同时，封不觉看到菜单里的“专精栏”解锁了，一共有六项专精，但其中五项的名称上都被阴影覆盖着，旁边显示着等级：NA，只有【通用】这项亮着，并显示着专精等级——F。
专精这块是惊悚乐园中玩家实力最重要的设定，读过游戏说明的封不觉自然记得很清楚，NA的级别含义是：无，一窍不通，无法使用该系技能；而F是：极差，接近于无，达到此级别时，即可使用该系的技能，发动成功率20%
在奖励显示的同时，电梯的门又，面积比这个电梯要大五倍左右，灯光从天花板内照下，房间中间有两根圆柱形的空心玻璃柱，此刻里面是空的。
封不觉对自己的惊吓值状况无话可说，当恐惧被“量化”为惊吓值以后，他竟然看到了三个零。至于那个恐惧评级，对封不觉来说意义不大，根据游戏说明，剧本结束后会根据惊吓值做出的评价有五种，分别是：浑身是胆，勇气可嘉，惊慌失措，胆颤心惊和魂不附体。
像封不觉这种全部为零的状况，是绝对不可能的，要不然设计者肯定会加个等级叫“胆大包天”。
对于新手教程来说，封不觉这次的完成度其实已是理论上的最好成绩，因为生存值和体能值与评分是无关的，毫发无伤和奄奄一息地通关在奖励上没有什么区别。
封不觉的奖励结算中，已没有一项可以更好了。但他并未表现出多少喜悦之情，只是叹口气，走到了左手边那根玻璃柱前，新的选项立即就在眼前浮现。
【请选择行囊的种类。】
虚拟的菜单投影上，出现了两种款式的背包，一种是斜背在肩上紧贴后背的样式，另一种则是横挎在腰胯部的类型。他稍稍考虑几秒，选择了第一种。接着，这个背包就由白光聚成，出现在了玻璃柱当中。待白光由虚化实，玻璃柱的半面就横向转动本小章还未完~.~，请点击下一页继续    喜欢惊悚乐园请大家
content_en:
Feng Bujue was surprised to find that the sword tore through the body of the bloody corpse as easily as cutting tofu. After the muscles and bones on the monster's chest were cut open, blood shot out and splashed all over Feng Bujue's face. A fishy salty smell filled his mouth and nose, and there was also a sticky and warm touch. This game can be said to be fake in this regard... just as disgusting as the real thing.
The bloody corpse was just cut by the sword, and it let out a painful roar. Starting from the wound, the body seemed to melt and quickly turned into meat paste and pus, flowing all over the ground.
Only then did Feng Bujue have the opportunity to take a look at the properties of the sword in his hand.
[Name: The Blood Corpse Must Die]
[Type: Weapon]
[Quality: Excellent]
[Attack power: strong]
[Attribute: None]
[Special effect: When attacking the blood corpse, it can be dissolved]
[Whether the script can be brought out: No]
[Note: This sword is an early work of the legendary dwarf craftsman "Al Quan Must Die". A cunning Goblin businessman purchased the sword from Or with a few bottles of a drink called "Erguotou". Half a month later, Or created "Goblin Must Die". 】
Feng Bujue looked at the attributes of the equipment for a few seconds before the system prompt sounded: [You have completed the novice tutorial and will be automatically transferred after 60 seconds]
At this time, another area was unlocked in the game menu in front of me, where a 60-second countdown was going on, and there was also an option to "transmit immediately." Feng Bujue chose to teleport immediately, and his body turned into white light and left the script instantly.
From a subjective point of view, it was just a flash of white light before his eyes, and he returned to the elevator. The giant sword in his hand was no longer there, and the blood stains on his body had also disappeared. Everything in the elevator was as usual, just as it was when the game was first loaded. The lights were bright, and naturally he was the only one in the mirror. What he had experienced in the past ten minutes was like a short, illusory nightmare.
[The script has been completed and the rewards are being settled. 】
[Experience gained: 70, game currency: 700]
[Items and equipment obtained: None]
[Complete acceptance task: 00]
[Special and hidden tasks completed: 0, world view cracked: none]
[Surge of fright value: 0 times, maximum fright value: 0%, average fright value: 0%]
[Your fear rating is: full of courage. You will receive an additional reward. Please select it later. 】
[Get skill value: 30]
[Skill value bonus experience: 30, game currency: 300]
[Reward for clearing the script: Novice bag*1. 】
[Settlement has been completed, please continue. 】
This information is displayed on the screen on the wall, and the system prompts: [You have reached level 2, and the upper limit of physical fitness has been increased. It is currently 200200]
At the same time, Feng Bujue saw that the "Specialization Column" in the menu was unlocked. There were six specializations in total, but the names of five of them were covered with shadows, with level: NA displayed next to them. Only the [General] item was lit, and the specialization level - F was displayed.
Specialization is the most important setting for player strength in Thriller Paradise. Feng Bujue, who has read the game description, naturally remembers it clearly. The meaning of NA level is: None, knowing nothing, unable to use the skills of this system; and F: Extremely poor, close to none. When reaching this level, you can use the skills of this system, and the activation success rate is 20%.
At the same time as the reward was displayed, the elevator door opened again. The area was about five times larger than this elevator. The light shone from the ceiling. There were two cylindrical hollow glass columns in the middle of the room. It was empty at the moment.
Feng Bujue had nothing to say about his fright value. When fear was "quantified" into a fright value, he actually saw three zeros. As for the fear rating, it doesn't mean much to Feng Bujue. According to the game description, there are five types of evaluations based on the fright value after the script ends, namely: full of courage, commendable courage, panic, trembling, and out of mind.A situation like Feng Bujue's situation where everything is zero is absolutely impossible, otherwise the designer would definitely add a level called "daring".
For novice tutorials, Feng Bujue's completion this time is actually the best result in theory, because the survival value and physical fitness value have nothing to do with the score. There is no difference in rewards between clearing the level unscathed and dying.
Among Feng Bujue's reward calculations, none of them could be better. But he didn't show much joy. He just sighed and walked to the glass pillar on the left. New options immediately appeared in front of him.
[Please select the type of luggage. 】
On the virtual menu projection, two styles of backpacks appeared, one that was worn across the shoulders and close to the back, and the other that was slung across the waist and hips. He thought for a few seconds and chose the first option. Then, the backpack was formed by white light and appeared in the glass column.
